title: Hyper relative differential operators on Lie algebras
summary: In this paper, we first introduce the notion of a hyper relative differential operator on a Lie algebra, in which Nijenhuis operators are used to characterize the relative differential operators and their inverse. We then introduce the notions of DN-structures, KN-structures, and KD-structures on Lie algebras and study the relationships between DN-structures, KD-structures, KN-structures, and hyper relative differential operators.
